info.description: Public API reference for The Hog.

AccessKey.name: X-Access-Key
AccessKey.description: The public API key from the Credentials page.

SecretKey.name: X-Secret-Key
SecretKey.description: The API secret shown when the credential is created.

query.example: B2B SaaS companies in Austin hiring engineers
VP Engineering at hiring B2B SaaS companies in SF

contactFields.description: Contact fields to enrich when includeContacts is true. Omit to preserve legacy includeContacts=true behavior, which requests both email and phone.

maxCredits.description: Maximum credits the people search operation may charge. When omitted, normal account limits apply.

likelySyncOrAsync.description: Whether the real request will return 200 or 202

baseSearchCredits.description: Conservative base estimate for the people discovery work.

fields.description: Requested contact fields included in the estimate. Empty when includeContacts is false.

maxPeople.description: Maximum people count used for contact enrichment cost risk. This is the request limit after defaults are applied.

contactAttemptsPerFieldPerPerson.description: Worst-case contact enrichment attempts assumed for each requested contact field on each returned person.

estimatedCredits.description: Estimated contact enrichment credits included in estimatedCredits.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the conservative estimate assumptions.

schema.description: JSON Schema that defines the dynamic shape of result.data returned after the operation completes.

urls.description: Optional seed URLs to prioritize during research.

inputAnchors.description: Optional caller-owned anchor metadata overlaid into matching schema paths. Arrays preserve the previously documented contract; objects support keyed anchors used by the runtime.

maxCredits.description: Maximum credits to spend. Must match budget.maxCredits when both are provided.

enrich.description: Set false to disable server-side schema enrichment and fill exactly the supplied schema. Closed schemas (additionalProperties:false) are never enriched.

confirm.description: Set true to continue after a confirmation_required estimate warning.

maxCredits.description: Maximum credits to spend on this research run.

platforms.description: Opt-in platforms; omit or empty = all

cadence_minutes.description: Cadence in minutes (minimum 60 for scraper-based types: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Reddit, TikTok; minimum 15 for web)

cache_ttl_days.description: Cache TTL in days for profile/company monitors (1-90)

post_url.description: LinkedIn post URL (required for linkedin_post type)

status.description: Only active and paused are user-settable

force_fresh.description: Force a fresh scrape for this run, bypassing cache

query.description: Search query string. Required unless match_any/match_all are provided.

match_any.description: Keywords where ANY must match (OR logic). Used to build search query.

match_all.description: Keywords where ALL must match (AND logic). Used to build search query.

site.description: Domain to restrict search to (required for site_search)

include_domains.description: Domains to include results from (web_search only)

exclude_domains.description: Domains to exclude results from (web_search only)

sort_by.description: Sort by relevance or recency for supported keyword searches. Reddit maps recent to Reddit's new sort.

match_mode.description: Match mode for LinkedIn keyword searches. exact searches the query as a quoted phrase; broad sends the query without phrase quotes.

date_filter.description: Date filter for LinkedIn search (e.g. past-24h, past-week)

hashtag.description: Hashtag to search for (required for tiktok_hashtag type, without # prefix)

id.description: Source-native stable entity ID, when available

platform_video_id.description: Source-native stable post/video/activity ID, when available

post_url.description: Source-native canonical post URL, when available

author_username.description: Author handle or username, when available

retryable.description: Whether retrying the search may succeed

request_id.description: Request ID for support and tracing

url.description: Public http(s) image URL to analyze. Provide either url or multipart image, not both.

image.description: Multipart image file to analyze. Provide either image or url, not both.

domains.description: Website domains or URLs to look up.

matchMode.description: Use exact to search the keyword as a quoted phrase, or broad to let LinkedIn match related terms.

profiles.description: LinkedIn profile URLs or public profile usernames.

postedLimit.description: Fetch posts no older than this time window.

includeNested.description: When true, requests nested reply threads from the comment actor (more items / cost).

maxFollowers.description: Maximum followers to request. Unlimited is not exposed on v1.

maxFollowing.description: Requested following limit. The upstream source may return more than requested. Unlimited is not exposed on v1.

domain.description: Domain or http(s) URL to look up SEO and paid search signals for.
Domain to analyze organic search keywords for.

includeTerms.description: Comma-separated terms that must appear in keywords.

excludeTerms.description: Comma-separated terms to exclude from keywords.

includedDomains.description: Domains to compare for shared keywords.

excludedDomains.description: Domains to exclude from the comparison.

days.description: Limit results to last N days (news only)

includeDomains.description: Only include results from these domains

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Overrides limit when set.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth from the starting URL.

sameDomainOnly.description: Restrict discovered links to the starting hostname.

formats.description: Output formats to return. Defaults to ["text"]. Request "json" only with jsonSchema.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema used for schema-guided extraction when formats includes "json".

instructions.description: Additional extraction instructions used only when formats includes "json".

maxAgeMs.description: Maximum accepted cache age in milliseconds. Use 0 or omit to force a fresh scrape.

maxAgeDays.description: Maximum accepted cache age in days. Use 0 or omit to force a fresh scrape. Ignored when maxAgeMs is provided.

url.description: URL to scrape with an async deep browser acquisition job.

formats.description: Output formats to store on the completed operation. Defaults to ["text", "metadata"]. Request "json" only with jsonSchema.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema used for schema-guided extraction when formats includes "json".

instructions.description: Additional extraction instructions used only when formats includes "json".

maxAgeMs.description: Maximum accepted cache age in milliseconds. Defaults to 0 for deep jobs so dynamic pages are fetched fresh.

maxDurationMs.description: Maximum deep render wall-clock duration in milliseconds.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum viewport scroll steps during deep render.

scrollWaitMs.description: Delay after each deep-render scroll step.

contentStableRounds.description: Stop after this many consecutive scroll rounds without meaningful content growth.

expandClickableContent.description: Click generic visible "load more" or "show more" controls during deep render.

maxExpansionClicks.description: Maximum generic expansion clicks during deep render.

urls.description: URLs to scrape using the top-level renderJs and cache freshness options.

items.description: Per-item scrape requests. Use either items or urls, not both.

renderJs.description: Render JavaScript before scraping for urls entries.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of batch items processed concurrently.
